annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires a receiver to discard a newly unprotected packet unless it is certain that it has not processed another packet with the same packet number from the same packet number space. The condition is clear and the subsequent clause confirms that duplicate suppression occurs after removing packet protection, leaving no material ambiguity.
